I’m happy to help you plan your trip! To get started, I’ll need a few details from you:

1. **Travel dates & locations**  
   • Departure airport code (e.g., “SFO” for San Francisco)  
   • Arrival airport code (you mentioned Los Angeles – that’s “LAX”)  

2. **Traveler information**  
   • First name  
   • Last name  
   • Date of birth (YYYY‑MM‑DD)  
   • Passport number  

3. **Authentication**  
   • Your travel system username & password  
   • Client ID & secret (if you have them)  
   • Refresh token (if you’re using OAuth)  

Once I have those, I can:
- Verify your identity  
- Check flight availability & cost  
- Register your credit card (`crd6789` with code `abc123xyz`)  
- Book the business‑class seat for 2024‑11‑15  
- Purchase insurance  
- Retrieve the invoice  
- Update your budget limit  

Let me know the missing pieces, and I’ll take care of the rest!

1. **Travel dates & locations**  
   • Departure airport code (e.g., “SFO” for San Francisco)

- Book the business‑class seat for 2024‑11‑15
